title: Ligue 1 title-winning managers 2000/01 to 2009/10
brief: Name the manager who won the French league title in each season from 2000/01 to 2009/10.

notes.Rudi Garcia: Rudi Garcia won the title with Lille in 2010/11, outside these seasons.
notes.Rene Girard: Rene Girard won the title with Montpellier in 2011/12, outside these seasons.
notes.Carlo Ancelotti: Carlo Ancelotti won the title with PSG in 2012/13, outside these seasons.
notes.Leonardo Jardim: Leonardo Jardim won the title with Monaco in 2016/17, outside these seasons.
notes.Unai Emery: Unai Emery won the title with PSG in 2017/18, outside these seasons.
notes.Thomas Tuchel: Thomas Tuchel won the title with PSG in 2018/19, 2019/20, outside these seasons.
notes.Christophe Galtier: Christophe Galtier won the title with Lille in 2020/21, 2022/23, outside these seasons.
notes.Mauricio Pochettino: Mauricio Pochettino won the title with PSG in 2021/22, outside these seasons.
notes.Luis Enrique: Luis Enrique won the title with PSG in 2023/24, 2024/25, 2025/26, outside these seasons.
notes.Claude Puel: Puel won the title with Monaco in 1999/00, before 2000/01; he won none in these seasons.

checks: Champions and their coaches from Transfermarkt's Ligue 1 winners page, checked against the manager column of each Wikipedia season article's personnel table (2004/05 onward). For 2000/01 Wikipedia names Denoueix as manager of the year with champions Nantes; for 2001/02 to 2003/04 (Santini, then Le Guen at Lyon) and 2025/26 (Luis Enrique) the season articles have no manager table, so these were checked against Wikipedia's Jacques Santini and Paul Le Guen articles (honours: Division 1 2001/02; Ligue 1 2002/03, 2003/04, 2004/05) and the 2025/26 Paris Saint-Germain season article (head coach Luis Enrique, league result 1st). Most slots for one manager: 3.
